title: Royalty OS C2PA Extension v3.0
description: A lightweight Royalty OS metadata extension schema for C2PA-style manifests. This schema describes machine-readable royalty, permission, trace-priority, and AI-usage metadata that can complement provenance records without replacing C2PA.

schema_version.description: Version of the Royalty OS C2PA Extension schema.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this Royalty OS metadata extension.

c2pa_context.description: Optional contextual references to a C2PA-style manifest, assertion, claim, or asset.

manifest_uri.description: URI of the C2PA-style manifest or external manifest record.

manifest_hash.description: Hash of the C2PA-style manifest or manifest payload.

asset_id.description: Identifier of the associated asset in the provenance system.

assertion_id.description: Optional assertion identifier associated with this Royalty OS extension.

signature_status.description: Signature or trust status of the associated manifest or claim, if available.

manifest_embedded.description: Whether the manifest is embedded in the asset.

external_manifest_resolved.description: Whether an external manifest or soft-bound manifest reference was resolved.

royalty.description: Royalty OS metadata associated with the asset, content, concept, structure, or knowledge object.

title.description: Human-readable title of the content, article, asset, concept, or structure.

author_id.description: Identifier of the author, creator, publisher, or registered contributor.

recipient_os_id.description: Royalty OS identifier of the potential recipient, rights holder, publisher, creator, or registered entity.

content_type.description: Type of content or knowledge object associated with this metadata.

version.description: Version of the content metadata or Royalty OS declaration.

permission_scope.description: Declared permission scope for AI systems, retrieval systems, indexing systems, or downstream usage.

preferred_usage.description: Preferred or expected usage categories that may map to Royalty Trace Event usage types.

attribution_request.description: Preferred attribution behavior requested by the creator, publisher, rights holder, or metadata issuer.

trace_priority.description: Suggested priority level for trace logging and review.

license_uri.description: URI of the license, permission statement, or usage policy.

policy_uri.description: URI of the Royalty OS policy, allocation policy, or rights policy associated with this content.

related_repository.description: Related repository, specification, or public source reference.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction or region associated with the permission or metadata declaration, such as JP, EU, US, UK, global, or unknown.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this Royalty OS metadata declaration was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this Royalty OS metadata declaration was last updated.

trace_policy.description: Optional trace-policy metadata that helps AI systems, RAG systems, or audit systems determine how to record usage.

trace_enabled.description: Whether trace logging is requested or enabled for this content.

trace_granularity.description: Preferred granularity levels for trace logging.

outlier_origin_tracking.description: Whether outlier origin detection is requested or relevant for this content.

allocation_trigger_allowed.description: Whether valid trace events may become allocation trigger candidates.

review_required_before_allocation.description: Whether human or multi-party review is required before allocation processing.

privacy_mode.description: Preferred privacy mode for trace events generated from this content.

retention_hint.description: Non-binding retention hint for trace records related to this content.

evidence.description: Evidence references that may support provenance, traceability, or later audit review.

content_hash.description: Hash of the content or asset associated with this Royalty OS metadata.

metadata_hash.description: Hash of the Royalty OS metadata extension object.

evidence_bundle_uri.description: URI of an external evidence bundle or audit package.

trace_receipt_uri.description: URI of a related trace receipt or trace receipt bundle.

registration_record_uri.description: URI of a registry record, publication record, or source declaration.
